MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Applications for approval of Transactions in Precious Metals
1. Reference is made to CLO Memorandum No. 212 (2.1), dated 15 January 1946, subject: "Control of Financial Transactions" and the attached list of applications for approval of transactions in precious metals completed subsequent to date of issuance of memorandum for Imperial Japanese Government, this Headquarters, file AG 130 (22 Sept 45) ESS, dated 22 September 1945, subject: "Control of Financial Transactions".
2. The Ministry of Finance may approve these transactions.
